headline: US futures point to a lower open as tech weakness persists ahead of 8:30 AM ET macro data releases
raw_text:
- S&P 500 Futures (@ES) fall 1.22%, Nasdaq 100 Futures (@NQ) decline 2.12%, Dow Jones Futures (@YM) drop 0.65%, and Russell 2000 Futures (@ER2) edge 0.86% lower in early trade
- Technology and AI names remain under pressure after Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, with Nvidia (NVDA) falling about 5% pre-market amid governance questions and mixed analyst reactions
- Deere & Company (DE) reports earnings before the bell, with traders watching agricultural cycle guidance and early trade reactions
- Li Auto (LI) gains about 5% pre-market after reporting Q3 revenue of RMB28.8 billion and a net loss of RMB309.7 million, and forecasting Q4 deliveries of 110,000–115,000 vehicles
- At 8:30 AM ET, the Q3 GDP second estimate, October core PCE inflation, durable goods orders, personal income and spending, and initial jobless claims data are due and expected to drive early volatility
- Overnight weakness in Japan and South Korea and mixed European trade set a cautious global backdrop for US markets
- Oil (@CL) and gold (@GC) futures trade lower in early dealings, with no major new geopolitical or corporate catalysts cited
